verdict.rationale: Elicit documents uploading PDFs to the Library in bulk with no stated limit, plus Zotero and RIS/BIB import. Collections built from those papers can launch reviews or extractions, and chat and extraction columns work over papers' full text. The docs never explicitly say the Research Agent session itself researches over a user-uploaded corpus, so the 'agent' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Research Agent can be scoped to uploaded PDFs or a library, and independent or hands-on corroboration of research over uploaded corpora.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them

citations.quote: There is no limit on the number of PDFs your library can hold at this time.
When uploading PDFs, simply click the "Add tags" button to create a tag or add an existing one to your newly uploaded papers.
Elicit's Zotero integration helps you bring your paper collections into Elicit, where you can extract data and analyze your papers!
You can import RIS and BIB files into Elicit.
Collections help you group related research, arrange it the way you want, share it with colleagues, and quickly launch reviews or extractions.
Columns can pull data from the papers' body text or from tables in the papers.
